marisol-cortez.text: Voted with a 7-0 council on Jan. 28, 2026 to accept a federal COPS hiring grant and raise Police Department staffing from 132 to 137 sworn officers ($1.03M total cost).

source.title: El Monte City Council Minutes, Jan. 28, 2026

marisol-cortez.text: Voted for Urgency Ordinance No. 3062 restricting use of city-owned or city-controlled property (7-0, Mar. 18, 2026); a public commenter addressed it as the urgency ordinance regarding immigration enforcement.

source.title: El Monte City Council Adjourned Meeting Minutes, Mar. 18, 2026

marisol-cortez.text: Voted to approve School Resource Officer agreement amendments with three local school districts for FY2024-25 and 2025-26 (5-0, May 28, 2025).

source.title: El Monte City Council Minutes, May 28, 2025
